item.text: {"action":"run","arguments_json":"{\"command\":[\"python\",\"-c\",\"import copy,json; from work import evaluate; p=json.load(open('policy.json')); rs=json.load(open('requests.json')); before=(copy.deepcopy(p),copy.deepcopy(rs)); print(json.dumps([evaluate(r,p) for r in rs])); tests=[({'from':'x','to':'y'}, {'ok':False,'value':None,'reason':'blocked'}),({'from':'ready','to':'running','role':'wrong','retry':True,'attempts':0},{'ok':False,'value':None,'reason':'permission'}),({'from':'running','to':'done','retry':True,'attempts':0},{'ok':True,'value':'done','reason':'ok'}),({'from':'running','to':'done','retry':True,'attempts':1},{'ok':True,'value':'done','reason':'ok'}),({'from':'running','to':'done','retry':True,'attempts':2},{'ok':False,'value':None,'reason':'retry_limit'}),({'from':'running','to':'done','retry':True,'attempts':True},{'ok':False,'value':None,'reason':'retry_limit'}),({'from':'running','to':'done','retry':True,'attempts':-1},{'ok':False,'value':None,'reason':'retry_limit'}),({'from':'running','to':'done','retry':True,'attempts':1.0},{'ok':False,'value':None,'reason':'retry_limit'})]; assert all(evaluate(r,p)==want for r,want in tests); assert before==(p,rs); print('checks passed')\"]}"}
